text: Could you make a short with a live-action look that tells this little story in three scenes? I like the idea of a small act of kindness being enough to make something worth watching. A young woman with a curly black bob and a yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. Somewhere in all this explaining I should mention that I want it silent, 15 seconds long, and widescreen. An older man with a white beard and a blue coat offers her his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile, and I want the overall feeling to be sweet rather than cheesy.
